http/cache_memory#

Cached responses and a cache in memory.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let cache = MemoryHttpCache(clock: SystemClock(), maximum: 67108864);
Caching(origin: HttpClient(), cache: cache, clock: SystemClock());

Description#

Cached responses and a cache in memory.

An entry holds a whole response: its head, its body bytes and trailers, read to the end first. MemoryHttpCache keeps entries up to maximum bytes, evicting the oldest. It keeps only 200 responses to GET, without no-store or Content-Range, and skips requests with Authorization unless told otherwise. Entries vary by Authorization, Cookie and the fields their Vary names; Vary: * is never kept.

role ResponseCaching

Explicit completed storage boundary: bytes/trailers are supplied only after clean body EOF by a consuming adapter. This store never opens a live body.
